summary: Prologis filed an 8-K announcing an indicative all-share proposal to acquire SEGRO plc, a UK industrial REIT, on June 16, 2026. Terms of the all-stock transaction are not specified in terms of price per share or premium. SEGRO's board unequivocally rejected the proposal on June 23, 2026. Prologis urged SEGRO shareholders to encourage engagement. Under UK Takeover Code Rule 2.6(a), Prologis must announce a firm intention to make an offer or walk away by July 22, 2026. The filing is a non-US takeover mapped to an acquisition. Watch for Prologis's next move: a possible hostile bid or walkaway.
